summary: Restored the consolidated settings workbench that had been over-reverted, including the two-pane Instructions & tools editor with System prompt / Global AGENTS.md switching and the wider Extensions layout (1180px shared with Agent/Skills). Reworked the workbench sizing so it tracks library content height instead of near-viewport height, and restyled the library heading as a muted caps label so it no longer reads like a third clickable row. Verified with `pnpm check`, the impeccable detector, and the full vitest suite (308 tests passing) before closing the browser tab.
decisions: Restore the consolidated workbench view (two-pane library + editor with System prompt / Global AGENTS.md toggle) rather than regressing to stacked cards.
Size the workbench to its library content (~440px) instead of near-viewport height, to avoid a large empty gray column.
Render the instructions library label as a small muted caps category label matching the sidebar group-label convention, not a bold title/description pair.
Share the 1180px settings-content width across `agent`, `skills`, and `extensions` pages so tab switching does not resize the page.
errors: Screenshot capture on the live dev server tab timed out once with `Page.captureScreenshot` CDP timeout; a retry succeeded.
